title: AppleSupportGoldenEvaluationItem
description: Schema for AppleSupport golden evaluation benchmark items (T3/T4)

thread_id.description: Unique thread identifier from subsample (e.g. twcs_apple_00146)

customer_tweet_id.description: Tweet ID of the customer's initial inbound message

customer_text.description: Exact text of the customer's first inbound tweet (primary input for intent & escalation)

brand_text.description: Historical resolution reply by @AppleSupport (reference context only, not used to label intent)

turn_count.description: Total number of conversation turns in the thread

created_at.description: Timestamp of the customer's initial tweet

intent.description: Ground-truth intent from canonical codebook (must be null until human labeling in T4)

escalate.description: Ground-truth triage decision (must be null until human labeling in T4)

escalate_reason.description: Ground-truth escalation reason code from canonical codebook (must be null or empty until labeled)

notes.description: Optional human annotator notes, edge cases, or ambiguity commentary
